newsitem.title: USA: Texas man, 3 sons killed in hunting accident.
newsitem.headline: Texas man, 3 sons killed in hunting accident.

text.p: A father and his three young sons were killed in a boating accident as they hunted for ducks on a northwest Texas lake, officials said on Sunday.
The family went hunting on Lake Meredith in the Texas Panhandle Saturday, but the winds picked up and their 14-foot flatboat capsized in bitterly cold waters as they tried to return to shore.

A spokesman for the Lake Meredith National Recreation Area, about 30 miles north of Amarillo, said the bodies of the father and one of his sons had been recovered and that air and land rescue teams were still searching for the two other boys.
He said there was virtually no hope of finding them alive. "We are pretty much discounting that. We are in a recovery mode."
The boys were aged 8, 9 and 11 and their father was 41.
Officials said the two bodies already found had life vests on and that it was not yet clear whether they had drowned or died of hypothermia.
They said high winds on the long, thin lake create difficult conditions, especially for inexperienced boaters.

The man's wife alerted park officials late Saturday when the group failed to return to their home in Amarillo. She said they had earlier called home on a cellular telephone to say the winds were picking up and that they were heading back to shore.
